text: I'm exhausted. I need a break. Can one of you cover for me?
Fine. We have a lot of options anyway.
Hey Earth! I'm Proxima Centauri, your closest stellar neighbor.
Wait… you're replacing the Sun?
Yep. What's the problem?
You're only about 12% of the Sun's mass. You don't have enough gravity to hold us in our orbits.
say: You're only about twelve percent of the Sun's mass. You don't have enough gravity to hold us in our orbits.

text: Uh… guys? Why am I moving away?
WAIT. I'M MOVING TOO!
Every planet is escaping. Our old orbits are gone.
And you're so dim, I'm losing heat fast. My days turn dark and freezing.
The oceans freeze from the top down, and most life on the surface won't make it.
Yeah… you're a little underqualified.
Move aside. I'm Sirius A. More than twice the Sun's mass, and about 25 times brighter.
say: Move aside. I'm Sirius A. More than twice the Sun's mass, and about twenty-five times brighter.

text: Finally! Someone who can hold us together.
Hold on tight.
Because you're heavier, my orbit stretches into a long oval. My year shrinks to about four and a half months.
But here's the real problem. At my closest point, I'm only a third of my usual distance from you.
And you're so bright, I get hundreds of times more energy than the Sun gives me today.
THE OCEANS ARE BOILING! WE'RE COOKED!
say: The oceans are boiling! We're cooked!

text: Wait… does that mean my icy moons could get warmer?
Bro, I'm literally being roasted, and you're thinking about vacation spots?
Hello, little planets. I've got this.
Wait. How big are you?
My outer layers reach beyond the orbit of Mars.
HOLD UP. I'M INSIDE YOU?!
SAME!
BRO, WE'RE LITERALLY INSIDE A STAR!
say: Bro, we're literally inside a star!

text: You're also about 18 times more massive than the Sun. But your size is the real nightmare.
say: You're also about eighteen times more massive than the Sun. But your size is the real nightmare.

text: Mercury, Venus, Mars and I are surrounded by your incredibly hot outer gas.
So… are we still a solar system?
I don't think we can call it that anymore.
So… how was the replacement?
Proxima couldn't hold us. Sirius turned us into toast. And Betelgeuse swallowed the inner planets.
So you missed me?
Bro, you're not perfect… but you're the only star I trust.
That's what I thought.
